npc_fire_dragon_walk.author: Austin Ginder (directed), Grok Bot in T3 Chat
npc_fire_dragon_walk.prompt:
Create ONE sprite sheet image: an 8-frame walk cycle for the baby fire dragon in the attached picture "dragon-design.png".

THE CHARACTER: Copy the dragon in "dragon-design.png" exactly: the same head, eyes, horns, wing, spikes, spots, colours, tail flame, outline and painting style. Same size in every frame. Side view, facing RIGHT. Only the legs, a small body bob and the tail move between frames. The head, eye, horns, wing and spikes stay identical in all 8 frames.

THE STRIDE: The attached "stride-guide-piggy.png" is Tiny Speck's own walk cycle for a Piggy, cut to 8 frames in the same grid this sheet must use. Use it only as a guide to how the legs move from frame to frame. Do not draw a pig.

THE GRID: 2 columns x 4 rows, 8 equal cells, read left to right, top to bottom (row 1 = frames 1 and 2, row 2 = frames 3 and 4, and so on). Square image, as large as possible (ideally 2048 x 2048, so each cell is 1024 wide and 512 tall).

THE LEGS: The dragon walks with its legs in diagonal pairs:
- Pair A = the NEAR front leg (closest to us) + the FAR back leg.
- Pair B = the FAR front leg + the NEAR back leg.
Draw the far legs (behind the body) a little darker than the near legs, so all four read clearly.
- Frame 1: Pair A reaches fully forward, feet just touching the ground. Pair B is fully back, pushing off on its toes. Body at its lowest.
- Frame 2: Pair A is planted and starting to move under the body. Pair B lifts off the ground.
- Frame 3: Pair A stands straight under the body. Pair B is lifted, swinging forward, its feet at their highest. Body at its highest.
- Frame 4: Pair A angles back behind the body. Pair B reaches forward, about to land.
- Frame 5: the mirror of frame 1. Pair B reaches fully forward, Pair A fully back pushing off. Body at its lowest.
- Frame 6: the mirror of frame 2. Pair B planted, Pair A lifts off.
- Frame 7: the mirror of frame 3. Pair B straight under the body, Pair A lifted and swinging forward. Body at its highest.
- Frame 8: the mirror of frame 4. Pair B angles back, Pair A reaches forward, about to land. Frame 8 leads smoothly back into frame 1.
The body bobs only a little: lowest in frames 1 and 5, highest in 3 and 7. The tail sways gently, opposite to the body bob.

IT WALKS IN PLACE, like on a treadmill:
- The body stays at the same left-right spot in every cell, centred horizontally.
- The feet on the ground touch the same invisible ground line, 85% of the way down each cell, in every frame.
- Nothing crosses into a neighbouring cell.

BACKGROUND AND CLEAN-UP:
- Transparent background if you can; if not, one flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) with no shading, no floor and no shadows.
- No magenta, pink or purple on the dragon.
- No grid lines, borders, frame numbers, labels or text.
inputs: sprite:npc_piggy walk (Tiny Speck, OGA CC0), every third frame as an 8-frame stride guide
